text:
clare: FYI from the monthly RBAC sweep: attestation webhook dropped updates for a subset of service accounts during the 2025-12 deploy window. found 9 admin bindings with stale evidence and 2 cross-project KMS grants. planning a short 'demote-first' trial to shrink blast radius. thoughts?
ben: can you share the svcacct list and the KMS audit IDs? i want to ensure we don't break nightly jobs.
clare: gist with details: https://gist.github.com/redwood/xyz789 (redacted). example svc: svc-ingest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com (roles/editor), svc-reports@... (roles/owner). KMS events: audit-id ka-20251205-01, ka-20251206-07.
sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_CROSS_PROJECT_GRANT (rule=kms-crossproj-2) - 2 events detected in 72h. See audit: https://console.audit/redwood/logs/ka-20251205-01 (redacted)
lina: recommend we run last-used checks before any change. if last-used >30d and no attestation, demote to roles/viewer with a 7d TTL. if last-used <=30d, open owner SLA (48h) then temp lower-privs if no attestation.
oncall: please notify oncall before runs and export the full audit slice. if anything weird happens, escalate immediately.
clare: proposed minimal playbook: 1) run last-used + evidence-synth 2) email owners with attestation link, 48h SLA 3) for OWNERLESS_STALE -> demote-first (viewer, ttl=7d) and tag event with SEC-DEMO. 4) owner can re-request via ticket with justification 5) if cross-project KMS grants -> hold and full sec-triage review.
ben: +1. add step to snapshot IAM bindings and service account keys (key metadata only). we should also throttle to avoid multiple simultaneous demotions in the same project.
lina: adding automation notes: entitlement-scan can produce CSV, then a small job applies IAM patches with an audit-only flag first (no enforced removal) so we can watch logs for errors for 24h before enforcing.
sec-bot: NOTE: automation-sim created sandbox patch for svc-ingest that will run in dry-run mode: link https://ci.redwood/sim/456 (redacted)
clare: scheduling sweep next Tue 09:00 PT. pinging owners now; will open ticket SEC-2025-333 and assign sec-triage + ops-east.
oncall: ack. will monitor PagerDuty low-severity on demote events.
ops-east: quick ops caveat: for rotation accounts we need to coordinate with the rotation job window or risk breaking rotations. if any binding targets rotation@redwood, skip demotion and flag for manual review.
clare: noted, will add skip rule for rotation accounts. thanks.
ben: i will prepare rollback steps and a short runbook snippet in the ticket.
clare: thanks everyone. starters: lina to run last-used scan, ben to draft rollback, oncall to standby. report back after the sweep. :thumbsup:
